title: Korean Herb Chicken Skewers
description: Delightful and easy-to-make Korean-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken skewers, perfect for a quick dinner or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Infused Oil
ingredients.notes: such as Gochujang or soy-ginger oil

ingredients.name: Herb Blend
ingredients.notes: such as chopped cilantro, parsley, or basil

instructions: 2. In a blender or food processor, combine infused oil, herb blend, garlic, sesame oil, soy sauce, honey, and ginger.
3. Add the chicken breast to the marinade and mix well.
4. Thread the marinated chicken onto the Korean skewers.
5. Brush the grill with oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. Remove from heat and let rest for 2-3 minutes.
8. Serve hot, garnished with additional herb blend if desired.
